Dialog_0.en: A warm surge rises in the Dantian, bringing a deep sense of comfort...
Dialog_0.cn: 隐隐感到丹田中有一股热气升腾，好生舒畅……
Dialog_0.ru: Теплая волна поднимается в Даньтянь, принося глубокое чувство комфорта...

Dialog_1.en: "The five organs generate five energies"...\nWhen the five elements flow in balance, the body remains unharmed...
Dialog_1.cn: “人有五脏化五气”……\n若令五行之气协调运转，脏腑自然无恙……

Dialog_2.en: Clear the energy pathways and remove blockages, allowing True Qi to flow freely...
Dialog_2.cn: 疏通经络，排解淤堵，可令真气畅行无阻……
Dialog_2.ru: Очистите пути прохождения Энергии и устраните блокировки, позволяя Истинной ци течь свободно...

Dialog_3.en: The energy sea opens wide, gathering Qi like rivers flowing into the ocean, ready for my command...
Dialog_3.cn: 气海洞开，内力犹如百川归海，汇集一处，供我取用……
Dialog_3.ru: Море Энергии широко раскрывается, собирая Ци подобно рекам, впадающим в океан, готовое по моей команде...

Dialog_4.en: "Guide the form with intent, lead the breath with form, and nurture the form with breath"...\nI should regulate my organs and keep my energy balanced...
Dialog_4.cn: “以意领形，以形引气，以气养形”……\n我应调理脏腑，保持五气通畅……

Dialog_5.en: Draw in energy and channel it through the crown,\nletting it flow through the body to strengthen my True Qi...
Dialog_5.cn: 采气合意，自头顶贯入以通全身，\n于我真气或有补益……

Dialog_6.en: "Acupoints connect to meridians, meridians connect to vessels"...\nWith clear pathways, energy and blood flow freely, strengthening my Qi...
Dialog_6.cn: “以穴通经，以经通脉”……\n脉气相通，自然气血充盈，内力丰裕……

Dialog_7.en: The five elements cycle endlessly, washing through the body like flowing water...\nOver time, my physique will become lighter, and my bones more flexible...
Dialog_7.cn: 五行之气流转不绝，如水冲刷四肢百骸……\n长期以往，必将身轻体健，筋骨灵活……

Dialog_8.en: True Qi roars through the body like crashing waves, surging with unstoppable force...
Dialog_8.cn: 真气鼓荡周身，宛若惊涛击岸，汹涌澎湃……
Dialog_8.ru: Истинная ци с ревом проносится по телу подобно разбивающимся волнам, вздымаясь с неудержимой силой...

Dialog_9.en: "The Dantian is like a wellspring, and the meridians like rivers"...\nWhen the rivers run smoothly, Qi naturally grows, flowing endlessly...
Dialog_9.cn: “丹田似井泉，经络如河川”……\n河川畅通，内力自然增进，奔流不息……

Dialog_10.en: Unblock acupoints and activate meridians,\nclearing stagnation like dredging channels, allowing elemental energy to flourish...
Dialog_10.cn: 疏通关窍，活血经络，\n便似为沟渠清淤化滞，利于蕴养五行之气……

Dialog_11.en: "When the mind stays within, energy remains steady"...\nThe stronger the spirit, the greater the True Qi...
Dialog_11.cn: “神不外游气自定”……\n精神越坚，真气越长……

Dialog_12.en: A tranquil heart, free from distractions.\nInner Breath flows like an unending stream...
Dialog_12.cn: 心如澄水，杂念不生，\n内息增长亦如水流，绵绵不竭……
Dialog_12.ru: Спокойное сердце, свободное от отвлекающих факторов.Дыхание Ниннера течет подобно нескончаемому потоку...

Dialog_13.en: By calming the mind and one with all,\nthe five elements flow more smoothly with every breath...
Dialog_13.cn: 静心止念，休养生息，\n一呼一吸间，五行之气流转更畅……
Dialog_13.ru: Успокаивая ум и становясь единым со всеми, пять элементов текут более плавно с каждым вдохом...

Dialog_14.en: "The Twelve Principal Meridians are like rivers, the Eight Extraordinary Meridians like lakes"...\nAs the lakes fill, True Qi accumulates...
Dialog_14.cn: “十二正经如江河，奇经八脉似湖泊”……\n湖泊蓄水，真气渐长……

Dialog_15.en: A warm surge rises like mist, a spring bursts forth.\nQi stirs and guides the flow...
Dialog_15.cn: 体内热流有如云气升腾，泉水奔涌，\n显然是我以内力相激，导引气机之故……
Dialog_15.ru: Теплая волна поднимается подобно туману, вырывается наружу источник. \NQi перемешивает и направляет поток...

Dialog_16.en: "Celestial Sense, Yin and Yang in balance entwined"...\nBy guiding Qi, I orchestrate the five elements like fish swimming through vast waters...
Dialog_16.cn: “天人感应，阴阳相和” ……\n以内力导引五气流转，宛如教小鱼遨游江海……

Dialog_17.en: "Purity of mind nurtures energy, and energy refines the spirit"...\nI circulate the Qi to generate True Qi effortlessly, like water overflowing its vessel...
Dialog_17.cn: “净意养气，气灵神秀”……\n以内力导引真气运转，如水满溢，收发随心……

Dialog_18.en: Gather the metal essence of the western soul, refining breath through resilience...
Dialog_18.cn: 聚西魄之金气，从革之姿，以调鼻息……
Dialog_18.ru: Соберите металлическую эссенцию западной души, очищая дыхание благодаря стойкости...

Dialog_19.en: Channel the wood essence of the eastern soul, concealing vision within its depths...
Dialog_19.cn: 聚东魂之木气，曲折之姿，以藏眼神……
Dialog_19.ru: Направьте древесную эссенцию восточной души, скрывая видение в ее глубинах...

Dialog_20.en: Harness the water essence of the northern spirit, attuning the ears to subtle resonance...
Dialog_20.cn: 聚北精之水气，润下之姿，以凝耳韵……
Dialog_20.ru: Используйте водную эссенцию северного Духа, настраивая слух на тонкий резонанс...

Dialog_21.en: Draw upon the fire essence of the southern soul, sealing energy within the tongue...
Dialog_21.cn: 聚南神之火气，炎上之姿，以缄舌气……
Dialog_21.ru: Черпайте огненную эссенцию южной души, запечатывая Энергию в языке...

Dialog_22.en: Absorbs the earth essence of the central mind, uniting the limbs in harmony...
Dialog_22.cn: 聚中意之土气，稼穑之姿，以合四肢……
Dialog_22.ru: Впитывает земную сущность центрального разума, гармонично объединяя конечности...

Dialog_23.en: Merge Yin and Yang into a singular flow, comprehending the true form of existence...
Dialog_23.cn: 聚阴阳之一气，混成之姿，以悟真形……
Dialog_23.ru: Слейте Инь и Ян в единый поток, постигая истинную форму существования...

Dialog_24.en: "Earth at center, breath takes flight, Yin's deep whisper births metal's light"...\nWhen directing spleen energy into the lungs, maybe...
Dialog_24.cn: “中土化气，少阴生金”……\n若引脾气入肺，或可……

Dialog_25.en: "From Taiyin, the waters rise, returning breath where Shaoyin lies"...\nWhen guiding kidney energy into the lungs, maybe...
Dialog_25.cn: “太阴生水，还气少阴”……\n若引肾气入肺，或可……

Dialog_26.en: "Yin and Yang in endless fight, metal and wood shift day to night"...\nWhen leading liver energy into the lungs, maybe...
Dialog_26.cn: “阴阳相克，金木相易”……\n若引肝气入肺，或可……

Dialog_27.en: "Taiyin transforms the breath, Shaoyang gives rise to wood's growth"...\nWhen directing kidney energy into the liver, maybe...
Dialog_27.cn: “太阴化气，少阳生木”……\n若引肾气入肝，或可……

Dialog_28.en: "The Taiyang ignites, its flames arise, returning breath where Shaoyang resides"...\nWhen channeling heart energy into the liver, maybe...
Dialog_28.cn: “太阳生火，还气少阳”……\n若引心气入肝，或可……

Dialog_29.en: "Yin and Yang in clash reside, earth and wood in balance guide"...\nWhen guiding spleen energy into the liver, maybe...
Dialog_29.cn: “阴阳相克，土木相调”……\n若引脾气入肝，或可……

Dialog_30.en: "Shaoyin lets essence flow, Taiyin makes waters grow"...\nWhen directing lung energy into the kidneys, maybe...
Dialog_30.cn: “少阴化气，太阴生水”……\n若引肺气入肾，或可……

Dialog_31.en: "Shaoyang gives birth to wood, while Taiyin restores the flow for good"...\nWhen leading liver energy into the kidneys, maybe...
Dialog_31.cn: “少阳生木，还气太阴”……\n若引肝气入肾，或可……

Dialog_32.en: "Yin and Yang in balance fight, fire and water blend just right"...\nWhen channeling heart energy into the kidneys, maybe...
Dialog_32.cn: “阴阳相克，火水相济”……\n若引心气入肾，或可……

Dialog_33.en: "Shaoyang transforms the breath of air, Taiyang ignites the flame's bright flare"...\nWhen directing liver energy into the heart, maybe...
Dialog_33.cn: “少阳化气，太阳生火”……\n若引肝气入心，或可……

Dialog_34.en: "Ziwei Enclosure gives birth to earth, returning breath to Taiyang"...\nWhen leading spleen energy into the heart, maybe...
Dialog_34.cn: “中宫生土，还气太阳”……\n若引脾气入心，或可……

Dialog_35.en: "Yin and Yang in boundless strife, metal and fire forge new life"...\nWhen guiding lung energy into the heart, maybe...
Dialog_35.cn: “阴阳相克，金火相合”……\n若引肺气入心，或可……

Dialog_36.en: "Taiyang ignites the breath of sky, from rushing air, the earth draws nigh"...\nWhen channeling heart energy into the spleen, maybe...
Dialog_36.cn: “太阳化气，冲气生土”……\n若引心气入脾，或可……

Dialog_37.en: "From Shaoyin, the metal gleams, returning breath to earth's deep streams"...\nWhen directing lung energy into the spleen, maybe...
Dialog_37.cn: “少阴生金，还气中土”……\n若引肺气入脾，或可……

Dialog_38.en: "Yin and Yang in boundless strife, water and Earth embrace in life"...\nWhen leading kidney energy into the spleen, maybe...
Dialog_38.cn: “阴阳相克，水土相溶”……\n若引肾气入脾，或可……

Dialog_39.en: "Clear the clutter, let truth remain. Find Zhending, pure and plain"...\nWith the scattered energy dispelled, my Psyche remains in security...
Dialog_39.cn: “祛除芜杂，以归真定”……\n如今虚浮之气尽散，心神大为安定……

Dialog_40.en: Cleansing body and mind, returning to the original state—everything resets to its purest form...
Dialog_40.cn: 清净身心，回复本真，一切尽归初始模样……
Dialog_40.ru: Очищение тела и разума, возвращение к первоначальному состоянию — все возвращается к своему чистейшему виду...
